sources.claim: CSV: RFC 4180 is Informational, not a standard; optional header, comma delimiter, double-quote quoting
JSON is a lightweight, text-based, language-independent data interchange format
JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON value per line, newline-separated
Avro container files embed a schema, binary encoding, compressible blocks; schema resolution lets newer schema read old data
Parquet is an open source, column-oriented data file format with compression and encoding schemes
ORC is a self-describing, type-aware columnar file format for Hadoop; indexes enable predicate pushdown; created for Hive
Arrow defines a language-independent columnar memory format; zero-copy reads
Delta Lake: ACID transactions, time travel, schema enforcement, MERGE/update/delete
Delta protocol: table = data files + _delta_log transaction log; readers see a consistent snapshot
Iceberg: table format with schema evolution, time travel, hidden partitioning, multi-engine access
Iceberg spec: tables over immutable Parquet, Avro, ORC data files; metadata files track snapshots; atomic swap commits
Hudi: upserts/deletes, incremental processing, COPY_ON_WRITE and MERGE_ON_READ table types
Arrow is primarily an in-memory format, but also defines the Arrow IPC file format (Feather v2) for on-disk storage; not prioritised for long-term archival
Avro spec (raw): object container file header requires avro.schema; single-object encoding carries only a schema fingerprint
Iceberg spec (raw): table format tracks individual data files; snapshots; full schema evolution; Parquet/Avro/ORC data files
Delta protocol (raw): data files + transaction log in _delta_log; ACID semantics
